query: Large workflows (541 nodes) drop from ~35 FPS to ~12 FPS when panning/zooming in the new comfyui frontend (v0.3.26-41) compared to v0.3.18-7. FPS degrades the most when zoomed out with all nodes in view.

desired.outcome: User profiling found deleting LoadImage nodes makes FPS usable again, implicating image-preview node rendering in the frontend. No fix was confirmed; issue auto-closed as stale. Proposed: reduce/remove preview-heavy LoadImage nodes or roll back the frontend version.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether solver profiles frontend rendering and implicates preview-heavy LoadImage nodes (deleting them restored FPS) instead of blaming GPU, VRAM, or raw node count.
